training_gate: All frozen validation/development and six native playback cases must meet timing/completion limits
quality_warning: 8 kbps / 96x54 is a survival rung; startup gain trades substantial visual quality
test_status: data/controlled-capacity-stress-v2 test split; sealed until all trained checkpoints are frozen

scenario_training.training_content: Envivio only; Sintel is reserved for transfer evaluation
scenario_training.budget: 120 episodes per fixed seed; same architecture, optimizer, reward, safety filter, and recovery settings as the reference model
scenario_training.test_policy: Do not access test split until training and checkpoint selection are complete

stall_tolerance_note: Allow 1 ms for floating-point/time-step noise in the per-trace rebuffer constraint. Raw rebuffer values remain unrounded in validation records.

checkpoint_selection_diagnostic.current_rule: highest mean log-bitrate reward among eligible validation checkpoints
checkpoint_selection_diagnostic.comparison_rule: highest mean frame-aligned VMAF on validation among checkpoints that meet completion/startup/per-trace rebuffer limits
checkpoint_selection_diagnostic.scope: diagnostic selection comparison only; no held-out test evaluation and no production checkpoint promotion
